Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: They introduced incorrect/ungrounded pricing by claiming a $45 single-day ticket from the “official Six Flags website” and a $99 season pass from a Facebook post. California’s Great America was a Cedar Fair park in 2024 (not a Six Flags-branded site), and ticket prices are date/demand dependent. Using an inappropriate source and unverifiable figures led to an unreliable savings calculation that downstream agents accepted.
